Definition
[Deck transformation group]

↗ def:covering-space ↗ prop:covering-unique-lifting \group Covering Spaces

Deck transformations of $p:\widetilde X\to X$ are self-isomorphisms of the covering. They form $G(\widetilde X)$; on connected $\widetilde X$, a deck transformation is determined by one point and only the identity fixes a point.
